name: Blue Star Ltd
title: Blue Star Ltd - 500067 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Blue Star's FY26 cost pass-through is only ~8% of a 13% required price rise, with management guiding UCP margin 8-8.5% and Sri City RAC plant at ~100% utilisation, with the next line decision deferred to October.

utilisation.quote: it is operating at 100% capacity, which is somewhere around 6.5 lakh units

capex.quote: What we were to invest last year, we said that we will postpone and look at it in October.

triggers.label: Sri City RAC plant at 100% utilisation
triggers.quote: it is operating at 100% capacity, which is somewhere around 6.5 lakh units

triggers.label: Next RAC line decision deferred to October
triggers.quote: What we were to invest last year, we said that we will postpone and look at it in October.

triggers.label: Price hike ~8% realised of 13% needed
triggers.quote: we would have realized up to 8% out of 13% price increase, 5 more percentage of increase will happen

triggers.label: UCP margin 8-8.5% held for FY27
triggers.quote: as far as this financial year is concerned, as we see today, we believe 8% to 8.5% is possible

triggers.label: Summer set in 13 April; primary pickup
triggers.quote: We have been waiting for the summer season to take off in a big way, which indeed happened on 13th of April.

guidance.metric: Segment 1 (EM projects & commercial AC) EBIT margin
guidance.quote: we want to continue to ma intain that 7% to 7.5% outlook
Segment 2, we want to maintain 8% to 8.5%, okay?
the annual capex can be anywhere in the region of around RS.250 Crore to RS.350 Crore
The outlook continues to be around 8% to 10% kind of growth

guidance.value: Rs 1,000 Crore to Rs 3,000 Crore in 3 years
guidance.quote: the MEP part of that RS.1,000 Crore has the potential to go to RS.3,000 Crore within 3 years

red_flags.label: Margin pressure through FY27 from commodity and plastic costs
red_flags.quote: The margins will be continuing to be under pressure until 2030.

red_flags.label: Channel inventory built ahead of price hike
red_flags.quote: They had bought inventory in December because there was an energy level change.

evasions.quote: There is no intent to stop our investments
What provision reversal I am not able to follow.
Sorry, Nikhil, about the balance sheet and capex.
